meta: Fake QR codes stuck over real ones at shop counters and parking lots: check before you scan so your money doesn't go to a stranger's account.

muc.title: A code stuck on top
muc.text: QR codes at shop counters or parking lots can have another code stuck over them, sending your payment to a stranger's account.

muc.title: Look first, read the name
muc.text: Watch for codes stuck on top, peeling edges or misaligned frames. When scanning, read the recipient's name before you transfer.

muc.title: Asked to log in? Leave
muc.text: If a public code opens a page asking for your bank login or an OTP code, leave immediately.

muc.title: Call your bank and the police
muc.text: If you've sent money or entered details, call your bank right away to lock your account, then report it to the police.

muc.title: Three steps before scanning
muc.text: Ask a chatbot, an AI chat assistant, for three steps to check before scanning a code, and save them as your wallpaper.

thu: Ask a chatbot for 3 steps to check before scanning a code, and save them as your phone wallpaper.
